root_cause.text: The bounce buffers allocated with __get_free_pages() using BOUNCE_BUFFER_ORDER (order 2, 4 pages) are incorrectly freed with free_page() instead of free_pages() with the matching order, causing memory leaks by only releasing the first page of each allocation.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies both the allocation error path and nx842_crypto_free_ctx() to use free_pages() with BOUNCE_BUFFER_ORDER instead of free_page(), as seen in the diff: `-		free_page((unsigned long)ctx->sbounce);` becomes `+		free_pages((unsigned long)ctx->sbounce, BOUNCE_BUFFER_ORDER);`. The CVE description confirms the mismatch.
